mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies at City Hall with a temperature of 54 degrees and a waxing crescent moon overhead.

The City of Verona has updated its list of polling locations to improve accessibility for all voters. You should verify your assigned polling place by visiting the My Vote Wisconsin website before heading out to vote, as your location may have changed from the previous election.

There is plenty to do in our community today, including yoga at Insight Wellness, ART House 360 Thursday night events, and trivia at Hop Haus. Looking ahead, we have live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow, followed by the Dane County Farmer's Market this Saturday.

Reviewing the police department's weekly recap, on October 7, officers responded to a collision on Basswood Avenue where a 17-year-old operating an electric motorcycle collided with a vehicle. The juvenile sustained minor injuries, and the parent was cited for permitting an unauthorized minor to operate the vehicle.
If you are looking for a sweet treat, Culver's is featuring Crazy for Cookie Dough today. The restaurant is currently closed for the morning but will open today at 10:00 AM to serve you.
